title: Light Weight
text: Light Weight. This is your typical microfiber towel. It's light weight and absorbent. It's not thick or plush. I personally find the microfiber material to not be very soft, but with that being said, it's not rough or scratchy either. It's minimally soft. Microfiber towels are fine and work well. They don't take up a lot of space, so they are good for traveling or day outings. When given a choice, I will probably pick the plush, thick towel, but these do have their purposes. I would use these to send with my kids to camp or to the pool instead of taking the super nice towels. They're not bad, it's just my preference.
